answer.see: Gray-to-white gradient screen with 'FPS: --' in top left. No visible logos, text, or UI elements. Appears to be a loading screen or initializing publisher logo.
answer.why: Acclaim titles show publisher logos at boot. The FPS counter and minimal gradient suggest the screen is still initializing. Turok Evolution (another Acclaim title) required START on early publisher logos.

answer.see: SAVED PROFILES menu: center box displays 'EMPTY PROFILE' in yellow; profile slot indicators below; bottom shows green A button (CREATE PROFILE) on left and red button (QUIT) on right.

answer.see: NAME YOUR RIDER screen with 'PLAYER ONE' shown as the default name. A keyboard displays all letters A-Z, numbers 0-9, DEL, SPACE, and OK button on the right. This is a name-entry screen following profile creation.
answer.why: Default name 'PLAYER ONE' is filled in. According to the rules, when a default name is filled in and the cursor is on DONE/OK, press A once to accept and proceed. This follows the pattern for Acclaim games like Burnout where the default name is accepted with a single A press.

answer.why: Game mode selection menu. CAREER is highlighted by default, but SINGLE RACE is the fastest path to gameplay (one down, one confirm).
